text: DSH Web Mobile Fix（DSH Web 插件，网页与移动浏览器）：修复 DSH Web 在手机和窄屏上的布局，并为移动端 overlay 模式提供便捷控制。它通过浏览器端样式覆盖设置面板、侧栏和聊天输入区的布局；主要功能包括窄屏设置面板重排、composer 操作栏保持单行、展开侧栏改为全屏显示，以及 overlay 下的侧栏切换、新建会话和返回聊天按钮。适合在手机或小窗口浏览器中使用 DSH Web 的用户。使用前需要 DSH Web profile；不需要额外 API Key，overlay 专属控制依赖宿主提供 overlay 模式。

DSH Web Mobile Fix adjusts DSH Web layouts for phones. It reshapes settings, composer, and sidebar views, and adds sidebar, new-session, and back-to-chat controls in overlay mode. For mobile DSH Web users; no API key is needed. Overlay controls require host overlay mode.
手机上打开 DSH 网页时，设置窗口能不能别挤成一团？
我想让聊天输入栏在窄屏上也保持整齐的一行。
DSH 的侧栏在手机上打开会把聊天挤没，有办法改成覆盖显示吗？
让手机浏览器里的 DSH Web 更适合触屏操作。
软键盘弹出来后，我希望聊天内容还能自动滚到最新消息。
需要一个手机浮层里的按钮，快速回到对话或开新会话。
Can I make the DSH settings dialog usable on a phone-sized screen?
I want the chat composer controls to stay on one row on a small display.
How can I use a full-screen sidebar drawer with DSH in a mobile overlay?
Keep the latest chat message visible when the on-screen keyboard opens.
DSH Web Mobile Fix 的功能「窄屏设置面板」：在宽度不超过 700px 时将设置对话框改为适合手机的布局，并让标签可横向滚动。
DSH Web Mobile Fix 的功能「单行聊天输入栏」：调整 composer 操作区及其工具、模式和按钮区域，减少窄屏下换行挤叠。
DSH Web Mobile Fix 的功能「全屏侧栏」：在窄屏展开侧栏时让其占满屏幕，并隐藏或收起聊天主区域以避免并排挤压。
DSH Web Mobile Fix 的功能「overlay 快捷控制」：overlay 模式添加侧栏切换和新建会话按钮，也提供返回聊天的入口。
DSH Web Mobile Fix 的功能「overlay 会话跳转」：可从 URL 参数或片段读取目标会话，并在工作区服务可用后打开该会话。
DSH Web Mobile Fix 使用 overlay 专属控件的前提是宿主识别到 overlay bridge、全局标记或相关 URL 参数；普通 Web 模式不会创建这些控件。

dsh-web-mobile-fix README · dsh-web-mobile-fix：[](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

Mobile layout fixes for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI.

A pure client-side CSS overlay that repairs the worst mobile breakages on narrow (≤700px viewport) screens, without touching any product source:

dsh-web-mobile-fix README · dsh-web-mobile-fix：- Settings panel becomes a full-screen column layout instead of a squeezed desktop layout
- Sidebar opens floating instead of squeezing the conversation
- Settings nav tabs fit on a single horizontal row
- Composer action bar fits on a single row without wrapping or layering

dsh-web-mobile-fix README · How it works：The plugin ships a browser half (`exports["./client"]`, declared via `dsh.client.platform: "web"`), discovered by the client-modules scanner and loaded from the boot manifest. It injects one `<style>` tag with `@media (max-width: 700px)` overrides targeting the product's stable `data-slot` attributes, and removes the tag on unload — fully reversible.

dsh-web-mobile-fix README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness Web profile (`dsh --profile web`), any recent 0.1.x release
- Selectors target product slot contracts; they are stable within a version line but may need small updates after a major product revamp

dsh-web-mobile-fix README · Method 1: Ask your DSH Agent (Easiest 🤖)：Just send this repository link directly to your DSH web chat and say:
> "Install this plugin for me: https://github.com/AcidGr/dsh-web-mobile-fix"

Your DSH coding agent will automatically execute the installation command and set everything up for you.

dsh-web-mobile-fix README · Method 2: CLI Install (Recommended)：Install from npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-mobile-fix
```

(Or install directly from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:AcidGr/dsh-web-mobile-fix
```
)

After installation, simply refresh your browser.

dsh-web-mobile-fix README · Method 3: Manual install (no pnpm / offline)：```sh
PROFILE="$DSH_HOME/profiles/web"                 # adjust DSH_HOME and profile name
mkdir -p "$PROFILE/plugins" "$PROFILE/node_modules/@dsh-profile"
cp -r dsh-web-mobile-fix "$PROFILE/plugins/mobile-fix"
ln -sfn ../../plugins/mobile-fix "$PROFILE/node_modules/@dsh-profile/mobile-fix"

dsh-web-mobile-fix README · Rollback：- Bundle install: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-mobile-fix`
- Manual install: delete the `mobile-fix` insert block from `cordis.patch.yml` (the plugin dir can stay or go)

No product source is modified; upgrades do not overwrite it.
